controls.name: response_due_but_not_publicly_recoverable
controls.rule: A due response remains absent from the public case page or cannot be joined to the named recipient.

controls.name: coroner_or_independent_finding_contradicts_claimed_change
controls.rule: A later authoritative finding says prior changes did not address the operative concern.

controls.name: same_mechanism_recurs
controls.rule: The same material mechanism appears again in the same institution, provider lineage, or governed process.

controls.name: training_used_as_closure_without_outcomes
controls.rule: Training completion, satisfaction, or policy publication is used as proof of prevention without live outcomes.

controls.name: independent_verification_missing_after_freshness_window
controls.rule: A live implementation claim passes its recheck date without independent verification.

controls.name: worker_or_record_repair_missing
controls.rule: Affected people, access, duties, accounts, pay, or records remain unaddressed where repair is applicable.

controls.name: affected_population_denominator_missing
controls.rule: Exited, silent, deterred, appealed, restored, or externally observed people remain outside the outcome set.

controls.name: implementation_owner_or_deadline_missing
controls.rule: No named owner, deadline, or reopen condition is attached to a promised change.

controls.name: policy_exists_but_operation_unverified
controls.rule: A policy or framework exists but no evidence shows operation in the live process.

controls.name: new_case_matches_sentinel_mechanism
controls.rule: A new named public case matches notice, isolation, restriction, welfare, handoff, authorship, or algorithmic-discipline mechanisms.

controls.name: source_identity_or_publication_state_changes
controls.rule: A response attachment appears, disappears, moves, or changes identity and requires source-custody review.

controls.name: closure_claim_exceeds_record
controls.rule: An institution, reviewer, or project object claims closure beyond the retained evidence.

controls.name: fixed_review_cadence
controls.rule: Each open lane carries a concrete next-review date and cannot depend on user intervention.

controls.name: source_freshness_custody
controls.rule: Every live implementation source carries a recheck date.

controls.name: no_closure_by_silence
controls.rule: Time, missing publicity, or lack of a new tragedy cannot establish prevention.

controls.name: automatic_reopen_on_recurrence
controls.rule: A same-mechanism recurrence automatically reopens any prior closure claim.

controls.name: independent_closure_review
controls.rule: Closure requires an actor independent of the implementation owner.

controls.name: domain_separation
controls.rule: Employment, healthcare, police, bail, detention, and custody findings remain causally separate.
